reviews.x: This product is very easy to use. I used it for 4 weeks. The first two weeks once in the am and once before bed. Then I just did once in the morning because I rubbed my eyes at night to much. I do both individual and strip lashes so my lashes are very thin. This product works fast and easy. No smell it’s not oily and it goes on easy. I used it on both my bottom and top eyelashes.

I was a little nervous using this. I have heard stories of people that have used other brands and how it irritated their eyes and burned. I also am a firm believer that last extensions look ridiculous (sorry) I appreciate a more natural look. While my lashes are pretty healthy as it is, I wanted to give this a try. I did experience a bit of redness around the eye (also dealing with seasonal allergies) but it was light and no burning or anything like that-no uncommon after introducing a new produ

reviews.t: Quick Daily Routine Brings Great Results
reviews.x: It's very easy to get into the routine of applying this every morning. Just run the brush across the base of your top and bottom lashes.  Wait at least a week for great results. This morning, my mom commented that my lashes look really long now and asked if I was using fake lashes! She had no idea I was using a growth serum. It really works!

The first photo was taken before I started using this amazing product. The second photo was after using the product once a day for only 7 days! I did not have bottom lashes before using this product. I am thrilled with the results and I know you will be as well!

I am happy with this Eyelash Serum. Applying the product twice a day, in the morning and in the evening,  on both eyelashes and brows. Definitely see the results, my eyelashes get longer, even though just a bit so far. This is not the first Eyelash Serum I've been using but it works better than the others, at least for me. The secret is being consistent, apply it EVERY single day. Highly recommend this product.

All my friends get eyelash extensions but I can't stand the process of getting them and it's very costly, decided to try this out and so far it has worked! Will continue to use to see more results, thank  you

claims.text: Reviewers widely report that the serum makes lashes longer and fuller, often noticing results within one to two weeks.
Many reviewers describe the product as easy to use and easy to fit into a daily routine.
Several reviewers mention using it on their eyebrows as well as lashes, with some seeing regrowth in thin patches.
Some reviewers say it is a more affordable alternative to expensive eyelash extensions or pricier serums.
A few reviewers report no irritation or burning, while one 3-star reviewer felt it was a waste of money compared to another product.
